definitions.explanation: A multi-day event of concerts held in one place, usually annually. In Japanese the word suggests classical or civic events with a program of scheduled performances; outdoor rock and pop events are normally called フェス instead.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{音楽祭|おんがくさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I'm going to the summer music festival.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{音楽祭|おんがくさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: An international music festival is held in this town every year.

examples.japanese: {音楽祭|おんがくさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{発売|はつばい}{開始|かいし}→発売開始：22166_hatsubaikaishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}→三十分：09672_sanjuppun⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れて→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Tickets for the music festival sold out within thirty minutes of going on sale.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {音楽祭|おんがくさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれる→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: a music festival is held
- {音楽祭|おんがくさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to perform at a music festival
- ⟦{国際|こくさい}→国際：01406_kokusai⟧{音楽祭|おんがくさい}: international music festival
- ⟦{映画祭|えいがさい}→映画祭：30642_eigasai⟧: film festival — the same {祭|さい} suffix for arts events

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦フェス→フェス：06697_fesu⟧: fes(tival) — the everyday word for rock and pop festivals, from English "festival"
- ⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧: festival — a traditional shrine or seasonal festival, a different kind of event entirely
